clean_room: Only genre-level sea-chart priority/readability inspiration; no copied layouts, assets, timings or rules.
home_port: Haven's Reach only; another port does not prove home start and never becomes the return beacon.
candidates: Only live in-tree enemies; exclude sunk, invalid and queued-for-deletion targets and pickups.
port_proximity: Only a ShipMotor in the player group can set port metadata or emit entry/exit observations.
placeholder_strategy: Reuse the external M290 replaceable beacon and stable complete individual GLB models; no modular ship assembly.
